en.hero_title: Know where you stand under Kenyan law.
en.hero_body: Describe your problem in your own words. HakiAI finds the provisions of Kenyan law that apply and explains them in plain language.
en.example_1: My employer fired me without notice. What are my rights?
en.example_2: My landlord locked me out of my house. What can I do?
en.example_3: The police arrested me. When must I be taken to court?

en.how_intro: HakiAI answers questions about Kenyan law using only the text of ten Acts stored on this computer. It gives legal information, not legal advice.
en.how_step_1: It searches the ten Acts for the sections that best match your question, both by meaning and by exact words.
en.how_step_2: It re-reads the closest matches and keeps the five most relevant sections. If your question is not about these laws, it says so instead of guessing.
en.how_step_3: A language model on this computer writes the answer from those five sections only, naming the Act and section for each point.
en.how_step_4: Every citation is checked against the five sections, and their full text is shown under Sources so you can check each claim.
en.how_covers_body: Only these ten Acts, as they read in the copies stored here. Case law, county laws, regulations and later amendments are not included.
en.how_limit_1: Answers can still be wrong. The model may combine two sections wrongly or draw a conclusion that no section states. Check the sources.
en.how_limit_2: The citation check finds citations of sections that were not retrieved, but not a correct citation attached to a wrong statement.
en.how_limit_3: Answers are slow on an ordinary laptop, often several minutes, and only one answer is written at a time. Others wait in line.
en.how_limit_4: Kiswahili is machine-translated and is a best-effort aid. Legal meaning can be lost; the English legal terms are shown in brackets.
en.how_limit_5: It is not a lawyer. For decisions that matter, speak to an advocate or a legal aid provider.
en.how_privacy_body: Everything runs on this computer: your question is not sent to the internet. HakiAI does not save your questions or answers. Only the optional feedback (your rating and comment) is saved.
en.not_found_body: There is no page at this address.
en.crash_title: Something went wrong on this page
en.crash_body: Reload the page to continue. Your settings are kept.

sw.question_placeholder: Eleza tatizo lako la kisheria kwa Kiswahili au Kiingereza
sw.disclaimer: HakiAI inatoa taarifa za kisheria, si ushauri wa kisheria. Hakiki vyanzo vilivyotajwa na wasiliana na wakili aliyehitimu kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
sw.fallback: Siwezi kupata kifungu mahususi kinachoshughulikia suala hili katika mkusanyiko wa sheria uliopo. Tafadhali wasiliana na wakili aliyehitimu.
sw.translation_note: Jibu hili limetafsiriwa na mashine kutoka Kiingereza. Tafsiri inaweza kupoteza maana ya kisheria; maneno ya kisheria ya Kiingereza yameonyeshwa kwenye mabano.
sw.untranslated_note: Baadhi ya sehemu hazikuweza kutafsiriwa kwa uhakika na zimeonyeshwa kwa Kiingereza.
sw.citation_warning: Baadhi ya marejeo katika jibu hili hayakulingana na vyanzo vilivyopatikana. Yahakiki kwenye sehemu ya Vyanzo.
sw.hero_title: Fahamu msimamo wako chini ya sheria za Kenya.
sw.hero_body: Eleza tatizo lako kwa maneno yako mwenyewe. HakiAI inatafuta vifungu vya sheria za Kenya vinavyohusika na kuvieleza kwa lugha rahisi.
sw.example_1: Mwajiri wangu alinifukuza kazi bila notisi. Nina haki gani?
sw.example_2: Mwenye nyumba amenifungia nje ya nyumba yangu. Nifanye nini?
sw.example_3: Polisi walinikamata. Ni lini lazima nifikishwe mahakamani?

sw.truncated_help: Ni mwanzo tu wa kifungu hiki uliotoshea kwenye muktadha wa modeli. Maandishi kamili yameonyeshwa hapa.
sw.copy_failed: Imeshindwa kunakili. Chagua maandishi badala yake.
sw.letter_hint: Badilisha sehemu zilizo kwenye [mabano] kwa taarifa zako kabla ya kutuma.
sw.letter_wait: Barua inaweza kunakiliwa na kupakuliwa jibu likikamilika.
sw.error_disconnected: Muunganisho na HakiAI ulikatika kabla jibu halijakamilika.
sw.error_busy: HakiAI inashughulikia maswali mengine. Tafadhali jaribu tena baada ya muda mfupi.
sw.error_rate: Maswali mengi mno kwa muda mfupi. Tafadhali subiri dakika moja kisha ujaribu tena.
sw.feedback_privacy: Ni tathmini na maoni yako tu yanayohifadhiwa, kamwe si swali lako wala jibu.

sw.today_empty_body: Kipengele kifupi cha kila siku kutoka kwa Sheria zinazoshughulikiwa na HakiAI kitaonekana hapa katika toleo lijalo.
sw.continue_empty_body: Swali lako la sasa huonekana hapa dirisha hili likiwa wazi. Hakuna kinachohifadhiwa baada ya kulifunga.
sw.eta_note: Unaweza kufungua kurasa nyingine; jibu litaendelea kuja.
sw.how_intro: HakiAI hujibu maswali kuhusu sheria za Kenya kwa kutumia maandishi ya Sheria kumi zilizohifadhiwa kwenye kompyuta hii pekee. Inatoa taarifa za kisheria, si ushauri wa kisheria.
sw.how_step_1: Hutafuta katika Sheria kumi vifungu vinavyolingana zaidi na swali lako, kwa maana na kwa maneno kamili.
sw.how_step_2: Husoma tena vifungu vilivyo karibu zaidi na kubakiza vitano vinavyohusika zaidi. Ikiwa swali lako halihusu sheria hizi, husema hivyo badala ya kubahatisha.
sw.how_step_3: Modeli ya lugha iliyo kwenye kompyuta hii huandika jibu kutokana na vifungu hivyo vitano pekee, ikitaja Sheria na kifungu kwa kila hoja.
sw.how_step_4: Kila rejeleo hukaguliwa dhidi ya vifungu hivyo vitano, na maandishi yao kamili huonyeshwa chini ya Vyanzo ili uweze kukagua kila dai.
sw.how_covers_body: Sheria hizi kumi pekee, kama zilivyo katika nakala zilizohifadhiwa hapa. Kesi zilizoamuliwa, sheria za kaunti, kanuni na marekebisho ya baadaye hayajajumuishwa.
sw.how_limit_1: Majibu bado yanaweza kuwa na makosa. Modeli inaweza kuchanganya vifungu viwili vibaya au kufikia hitimisho ambalo hakuna kifungu kinasema. Kagua vyanzo.
sw.how_limit_2: Ukaguzi wa marejeleo hupata marejeleo ya vifungu ambavyo havikupatikana, lakini si rejeleo sahihi lililoambatanishwa na kauli isiyo sahihi.
sw.how_limit_3: Majibu huchelewa kwenye kompyuta ya kawaida, mara nyingi dakika kadhaa, na jibu moja tu huandikwa kwa wakati mmoja. Mengine husubiri kwenye foleni.
sw.how_limit_4: Kiswahili kimetafsiriwa na mashine na ni msaada wa kadiri iwezekanavyo. Maana ya kisheria inaweza kupotea; maneno ya kisheria ya Kiingereza yanaonyeshwa kwenye mabano.
sw.how_limit_5: Si wakili. Kwa maamuzi muhimu, zungumza na wakili au mtoa msaada wa kisheria.
sw.how_privacy_body: Kila kitu huendeshwa kwenye kompyuta hii: swali lako halitumwi kwenye mtandao. HakiAI haihifadhi maswali wala majibu yako. Ni maoni ya hiari tu (ukadiriaji na maoni yako) yanayohifadhiwa.
sw.crash_body: Pakia upya ukurasa ili kuendelea. Mipangilio yako imehifadhiwa.
